200.summary: Warsaw records EU’s highest employment rate Oct 8, 2026 | Business , Society Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! In addition to topping the overall employment rate ranking, Warsaw also had the third lowest rate of youth employment (for people aged 15-29) at 3.9%, higher only than Yugozapaden in Bulgaria (3.8%) and Zeeland in the Netherlands (3.6%).
200.body: Warsaw records EU’s highest employment rate Oct 8, 2026 | Business , Society Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! The Warsaw region, which includes Poland’s capital and its suburbs, had the highest employment rate in the European Union last year, according to new Eurostat data. After Warsaw, the second-highest employment rate in Poland was recorded in the central Łódź province (80.8%) while the lowest was in the southeastern Subcarpathian province (73.2%). In addition to topping the overall employment rate ranking, Warsaw also had the third lowest rate of youth employment (for people aged 15-29) at 3.9%, higher only than Yugozapaden in Bulgaria (3.8%) and Zeeland in the Netherlands (3.6%).

300.body: Ringsted Dun enters Polish market in partnership with SENPO Ringsted Dun is proud to announce its official launch in Poland through a new partnership with SENPO, one of Poland's leading sleep specialists. The partnership marks an important step in Ringsted Dun's international development and brings our Danish-made down duvets and pillows to Polish consumers. © SENPO For more than 75 years, Ringsted Dun has been dedicated to creating high-quality duvets and pillows, combining Scandinavian craftsmanship, carefully selected materials and a strong focus on sleep comfort. Kristian, DYKON, says: "We are very excited to introduce Ringsted Dun to the Polish market together with SENPO. We look forward to building the brand together and introducing more Polish consumers to Danish-made down duvets." The launch is the beginning of a long-term collaboration between Ringsted Dun and SENPO, with a shared ambition to develop the brand and strengthen awareness of Scandinavian sleep comfort in Poland.

Poland’s state-owned National Development Bank (BGK) has announced the launch of the country’s first fund to support companies developing space technologies. 400.title: Cadeler completes its turbine installation campaign at Baltic Power, Poland’s first offshore wind farm
400.summary: Cadeler completes its turbine installation campaign at Baltic Power, Poland’s first offshore wind farm AJOT Newsroom | Oct 07 2026 at 11:36 AM Cadeler has completed its turbine installation campaign for all the 76 wind turbines at the 1.2 GW Baltic Power offshore wind farm in the Baltic Sea.
400.body: Cadeler completes its turbine installation campaign at Baltic Power, Poland’s first offshore wind farm AJOT Newsroom | Oct 07 2026 at 11:36 AM Cadeler has completed its turbine installation campaign for all the 76 wind turbines at the 1.2 GW Baltic Power offshore wind farm in the Baltic Sea. This milestone marks the completion of Poland's first offshore wind farm, with the turbine installation executed using two of Cadeler's jack-up vessels, Wind Osprey and Wind Mover. The project represents a significant milestone for Poland’s offshore wind sector, both as the country’s first offshore wind farm and in terms of the scale and complexity of its execution. Mikkel Gleerup, CEO of Cadeler, comments: “We are pleased to have completed the installation of all 76 turbines at Baltic Power – Poland’s first offshore wind farm.
